title: Anthropic Stock Closes First Day at $97, Up 17%
dek: The Claude maker's Nasdaq debut values it near $1.27 trillion.

facts.label: Raised, the largest IPO on record

caption:
Anthropic just became a trillion-dollar public company on day one. 📈

The Claude maker's stock, ticker ANT on the Nasdaq, closed its first trading day at $97.17, about 17% above its $83 IPO price. Shares opened at $111.50, briefly valuing the company at more than $2 trillion, then cooled to a market value of roughly $1.27 trillion. The IPO raised $81.3 billion, topping SpaceX's $75 billion raise in June.

Why it matters: Anthropic is the first frontier AI lab to go public, while OpenAI has held off for now. Revenue hit about $16 billion in the first half of 2026, but losses and compute bills with Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Broadcom are just as massive. Chip stocks like Nvidia slipped while ANT held its gains.

For Claude and Claude Code users, nothing changes overnight. We at AI Parabellum will be watching pricing, release pace and safety promises now that quarterly earnings are in play.
